sourceFacts: female, age thirty-one, Brazilian and unofficial liaison for the foreign resident community, ordinary
tall, wears her hair in a very high ponytail and favors bright loosely cut coats
currently fitted with a custom integrated bilateral-leg and spinal prosthesis using an EEG interface and undergoing adaptation rehabilitation
the prosthesis is a medical body state rather than combat enhancement, awakened equipment or an exaggerated exoskeleton; nationality alone does not determine complexion
designAssumptions: provisional mixed Brazilian appearance with warm medium-brown skin, dark brown curly hair in a very high ponytail, brown eyes, visible fatigue and an uncertain rehabilitation expression rather than heroic confidence
wears a bright loose yellow short coat draped open around the shoulders over a high-neck charcoal rehabilitation bodysuit, leaving the center of the back readable

both biological legs are replaced from the upper thighs downward by matching slim matte white-and-graphite medical prosthetic legs with realistic flat feet; two enclosed hip interfaces join one smooth narrow segmented medical casing centered over the spine from pelvis to upper back
shown in a vulnerable front three-quarter view, shoulders slightly slouched and both hands tense around one plain grey forearm crutch while relearning balance
2026-08-29 visual refresh: the integrated spinal column, bilateral hip sockets, articulated upper-thigh prostheses and visible EEG temple ports paired with loose rehabilitation streetwear
User-review crop correction: strict head-to-mid-thigh cowboy shot; lower legs and feet stay outside the image.
sceneConcept: A tall thirty-one-year-old Brazilian community liaison is framed from head to mid-thigh during early rehabilitation. In a front three-quarter view, her shoulders slouch slightly and her worried, exhausted face avoids heroic confidence. A loose yellow coat falls around a charcoal rehabilitation bodysuit. Visible EEG temple ports, a segmented medical spinal casing, bilateral hip sockets and articulated upper-thigh prosthetic joints make the extent of reconstruction unmistakable. She grips one plain forearm crutch while relearning balance under soft even frontal studio light.
naturalLanguageDetail: A tall thirty-one-year-old Brazilian woman with warm medium-brown skin and a very high curly ponytail looks worried and physically exhausted rather than heroic, her shoulders slouched while she grips one forearm crutch; visible EEG temple ports, segmented spinal casing, bilateral hip sockets and articulated upper-thigh prosthetic joints reveal extensive medical reconstruction beneath a loose yellow rehabilitation coat; the portrait is framed from head to mid-thigh in a strict cowboy shot, with lower legs and feet outside the image under soft even frontal studio light.
